instruction: Schedule auto-save to perform backups of presentation work every five minutes.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting auto-save interval to 5 minutes in LibreOffice Impress via Tools > Options > Load/Save > General settings. The evaluator uses the existing check_auto_saving_time metric to verify the AutoSaveTimeIntervall value in registrymodifications.xcu matches 5 minutes. This is a paraphrased variation of the original task with a different time interval.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_vm_file fetches the correct LibreOffice configuration file (/home/user/.config/libreoffice/4/user/registrymodifications.xcu) that stores auto-save settings

Metric logic is correct: check_auto_saving_time correctly parses XML, navigates to the right path (/org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/Document), extracts AutoSaveTimeIntervall property, and compares it to the expected 5 minutes
Expected value is semantically correct: minutes=5 matches the instruction requirement exactly
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies all requirements in the instruction (auto-save interval = 5 minutes)
Data flow is correct: VM file fetch -> XML parse -> value extraction -> comparison to expected value
Robust error handling: handles FileNotFoundError, ParseError, and missing autosave settings gracefully
No postconfig needed: LibreOffice config file persists after settings are changed
Practical feasibility: the file path and XML structure are correct for LibreOffice 4.x configuration
